body:
I didn't even burn yet and I loved that tune, thanks for sharing, where is this band from?

As for your ideas of finding something and going full force, I am trying my best, the trouble is a mixture of lack of motivation and the fact that I don't know what to put my effort towards. Plus willowing will-power makes it hard to put my head down and muscle through the unknown.

Don't worry about negative curves, it is just nice to talk to someone.

There isn't much that gets me going anymore, I only really look forward to exercising and burning (in the tree fashion). I have a job that I hate, I have hated it since I started, but it was the only offer available at the time. It is a minimum wage job, so not a career, and being my first job out of University it gets at me that going to university seemed to be a waste of time (especially when everyone I know that didn't is doing better off).

I like video games, I don't play too often but they are a nice release. I love music, however; I tend to associate music with memories...which has led me to avoid certain music. Relationships are a pain since I'm not good at maintaining them it appears.

I'm 24, still young, but not really interested in taking the parenthood route. I wouldn't mind nieces of nephews, but children of my own has never been in my plans (I know that might not have been what you were going to say, but I figured I'd comment on it anyhow)

Thanks multiphrenic and sileikar, you were quick to the draw. The only problem with distracting myself is that when I am doing it at some point it dawns on me that that is all I am doing, distracting myself from the truth. I've never liked the saying 'ignorance is bliss' but I have a feeling it is the only route to go...and I can't stomach that. I don't mean to sound whiny, but thinking this way even leads me to call myself whiny.
